exposure: Intracranial tumor compressing the optic apparatus
Timing of neurosurgical intervention (during pregnancy vs. postpartum)
cohort: Pregnant women with visual deterioration due to intracranial tumors compressing the optic apparatus
finding: Surgery for intracranial tumors compressing the optic apparatus is well-tolerated during pregnancy and postpartum, resulting in improved visual acuity and good neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Of the five patients who underwent surgery after delivery, three required urgent cesarean section either due to acute visual deterioration or obstetrical reasons.
